snippet.title: WHAT SURROUNDS US - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
WHAT SURROUNDS US is out now on Steam! 🧩🌱

Explore an abstract ecosystem in What Surrounds Us, a cozy indie puzzling adventure. Encounter unique species and solve environmental challenges to protect their colourful habitat. Find your way through curious biomes and overcome the threat looming over this peaceful little world. 

➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4178950/

#gametrailer #gametrailers #indiegame #puzzlegame #cozygames
